workload_summary: Primary workload: classroom copilot (multi-turn chat for teachers and students) + automated moderation for student-generated content. Latency targets: sub-300ms median for short prompts; acceptable tail up to 700ms for grading tasks. Throughput: spikes to ~50 req/s during school hours, steady 5-10 req/s otherwise. Cost sensitivity: high; goal is <$0.002/token average for production. Model preferences: prefer small/efficient open models for routine chat, ability to fallback to higher-capacity models for rubric-based grading. Routing: cost-first routing with latency-sensitive fallback. Compliance: SAML SSO, audit logs, 30-day retention default (legal asked for residency note).
